name: horolog
description: Open-source, self-hosted AI calendar that defends your time.

scripts.test: npm run test:launcher && cd services/api && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
scripts.check: npm run test:launcher && npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:api: cd services/api && .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/mypy horolog && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
scripts.check:web: cd apps/web && npm run typecheck && npm run build
